reasoning:
Taking the square root of both sides of the equation $(x - k)^2 = 4k^2$ yields $x - k = \pm 2k$. 
This leads to two possible cases:
1) $x - k = 2k \implies x = 3k$
2) $x - k = -2k \implies x = -k$
Thus, the solutions are $x = -k$ or $x = 3k$, which corresponds to option C.
